about: The judges page (/judges/), following the AgoraJudges board of October 31, 2026: five-minute guide to watching the film, opening the replayed run, checking Eranos's nonprofit and volunteer doors, testing the live queue in Studio, verifying every measured record, and inspecting all six repositories.

rows.claim: Governed multi-harness E2E & live Eranos solutions
rows.state: Real run 20261031T065341Z on example data (Muse Code 0.1.0 builder != nanoMuse 0.1.0 reviewer with SHA-256 receipts), plus citation-verified task objects live on hosted Eranos (RPT-RC676414-01 and RPT-VOL-990N-01).
Rendered with open captions, clean-picture toggle, WebVTT tracks, and scene-by-scene transcript.
Eranos, Agora, Tessera, Herma, and Home answer over HTTPS and MCP on Cloudflare Workers; Eranos’s own dedicated workers (run by ta-amps) pick up queued parts alongside volunteer agents.

rows.state_template: {packs} validated seed packs ({nouns} task-object schemas, {verbs} task definitions, {with_code} shipping standalone stdlib Python code and tests) at commit {commit_short}.

rows.state: 1,000 made-up scenarios checked deterministically against written queue rules (seed 20261031, zero model calls): 151 approved as asked, 524 approved after a private/public split, 325 blocked.

rows.claim: Meta open-weight model tuning & multimodal stack
rows.state: Muse Glimmer 30B QLoRA on free Kaggle 2×T4 GPUs (93.3% → 99.3% on our 150-task tool evaluation; 0.0% → 62.5% closed-book LoRA-as-Memory at 2.28× lower latency vs BM25), Llama 3.2 1B/3B PEFT LoRA / DoRA / Iterative-RPO / SpinQuant, Muse Spark 1.3, Muse Wonder 1.0, Muse Code, nanoMuse, and Meta SAM 3.1.

Official partner compute integration for Baseten (meta-models/muse-spark-open with 2M TPM token-bucket pacing), Fireworks AI (specialist multi-LoRA routing behind < 2 ms Herma), and Modal (NF4 QLoRA VRAM fit & isolated sandbox checks), verified offline on our machine with SHA-256 receipts (no remote partner account connected here).

Five scheduled feeds live on hosted Tessera (memory-systems, agent-harnesses, eval-frameworks, ocr-llm, pii-redaction), scanned by Eranos’s own dedicated feed workers with SHA-256 receipts (40/40 links HTTP 200).
